en.t: Yugiri went to pay his respects to his father.

units.source_text: 源氏早已闻知他和落叶公主之事，但他想：“我又何必装作知道呢。”

en.t: Genji had long since heard about the matter between him and Princess Ochiba, but he thought, "Why should I let on that I know?"
He merely gazed at Yugiri in silence.

units.source_text: 但见他长得相貌堂堂，眉清目秀，正当精力充沛的盛年。

en.t: He saw that Yugiri had a dignified bearing and handsome, refined features, and was in the prime of vigorous manhood.

units.source_text: 他想：“这样的美男子，即使干些风流勾当，别人也不会非难，鬼神也应该赦罪的。

en.t: He thought, "For such a beautiful man, even if he indulges in romantic affairs, others will not condemn him, and even the spirits should forgive his sins.

units.source_text: 那艳丽清秀之相，横溢着青春蓬勃之气，但又没有不识世情的幼稚之相。

en.t: His radiant and graceful appearance overflowed with youthful vitality, yet showed none of the childishness of someone ignorant of the world.

units.source_text: 圆满成熟，无可指疵，此时寻花问柳，也是理之当然。

en.t: He is fully mature and without any flaw to point out, so at this age it is only natural for him to seek love.

units.source_text: 女人怎么会不恋慕他呢？

en.t: How could women fail to fall in love with him?

units.source_text: 揽镜自视，又安得不自豪呢？”

en.t: If he takes up a mirror and looks at himself, how could he not feel proud?"

units.source_text: 他看了自己的儿子，心中作如是想。

en.t: Looking at his own son, he thought this in his heart.
